contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Yes, YesStyle has an app for Android and iPhone, using the same account as the website. In the app, CECILIA010, a reward code, goes in the "Influencer / Rewards Code" field at checkout, next to "Coupon Code".

contentSections.heading: Where to download the app
paragraphs: YesStyle says the app should only be downloaded from the two official links. Don't install it from anywhere else.
In the app stores, as of 10/28/2026:
bullets: Google Play: rated 4.4, with 164 thousand reviews.
postParagraphs: Per the store's help center, the app runs on iOS and Android. On the home screen, the app opens on the Korean beauty showcase, with the Home, Shop, Bag, Saved and Account tabs at the bottom.

contentSections.heading: How to shop in the app
paragraphs: Shopping follows the same steps as on the website: sign in, fill your bag, go to checkout. Three points the store's help center confirms:
bullets: The account is the same as on the website. You don't need to create another one.
Sign in before adding items to the bag. When you're logged in on both the website and the app, there is a single shared bag.
At checkout, the app shows the delivery country, the shipping cost and the "Coupon or Influencer / Rewards Code" line before the order summary.
postParagraphs: The website walkthrough is in [How to use CECILIA010 on YesStyle](/en/reviews/yesstyle-reward-code-coupon-cecilia010).

contentSections.heading: Where CECILIA010 goes in the app
paragraphs: CECILIA010 is a reward code, not a coupon: it gives up to 5% extra (5% on the first purchase and 2% on later ones) and stacks with YesStyle coupons. In the app, it has its own field. Tested on the Android app, with an English-language account and delivery to the United States, without completing a purchase.
bullets: At checkout, tap "Enter Code" on the "Coupon or Influencer / Rewards Code" line.
Two fields open: "Coupon Code" on top, for the store coupon, and "Influencer / Rewards Code" below. Type CECILIA010 in the lower one and tap "APPLY".
Back at checkout, the code appears as a tag under "Coupon or Influencer / Rewards Code", and the summary gains an "Influencer Code Discount" line. Check that line before you pay.
postParagraphs: The store coupon, when one is active, goes in the top field, on the same screen. The two stack.

contentSections.heading: YS points and the app coupon
paragraphs: The 50 YS points apply only to the first download of the app with a sign-in to your account: if you have already used the offer, sign in on another device or reinstall the app, you don't get them again. The store's terms say the points arrive after one day, while the app page says it is immediate. The points are not the reward code: they are applied at the "Payment Information" step of checkout, while CECILIA010 goes on the "Enter Code" screen. One doesn't replace the other.

The store says it releases, once a month and at a random time, a 24-hour coupon that only works on orders placed through the app; when the app was tested there wasn't an active one, and the coupon featured in the app was the same as on the website. Since it comes and goes, the store's active coupons are on [YesStyle coupons and reward code](/en/coupons/yesstyle).

contentSections.heading: If the app doesn't work
paragraphs: Check these three points. If the problem persists, use YesStyle’s help center.
bullets: Download only from the official App Store and Google Play links.
Use your website account. Don't create a new account for the app.
Sign in before adding items to the bag. Without logging in, the app's bag doesn't merge with the website's.
postParagraphs: On store safety, [Is YesStyle legit?](/en/reviews/is-yesstyle-legit-and-safe-review) has the answer.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does YesStyle have an app? Yes, for Android and iPhone, at the official Google Play and App Store links. The store says to download only from those two.

Does CECILIA010 work in the app? Yes. At checkout, tap "Enter Code" and type the code in the "Influencer / Rewards Code" field. It is a reward code, with up to 5% extra, and it stacks with the store coupon, which goes in the "Coupon Code" field.

Do I earn points for downloading the app? Yes, once per account: 50 YS points on the first download of the app with a sign-in. Reinstalling or using another device doesn't give them again, and the points are not the reward code.

Does the app have an exclusive coupon? The store says it publishes a 24-hour coupon, once a month, only for orders in the app. When the app was tested there wasn't an active one; the active coupons are on the store page.
